Perks › Epic

Pip Alchemy

Epic perk · Active ability

Once per round, choose a bone and change each value to its double-six complement.

In-game card text

How it works

Choose one of your bones and change each half to its double-six complement: every number becomes 6 minus itself. A 1-4 becomes 5-2, a 6-6 becomes 0-0, and 3-3 stays 3-3.

  • You see the result before confirming.
  • The bone stays private and you don't have to play it this turn.
  • Each copy gives one use per hand.

At a glance

RarityEpic
TypeActive ability
UsesOne use per hand for each copy you hold. Uses refill at the start of every hand.
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 900 Bone Bucks once you own 5 Rare perks.
